_comment: The canonical nanoGPT operating point for this project. Every value below is read from the vendored record set at harness/records/track_3_optimization/train_gpt_simple.py and its README, never invented. A slot replicates this file into its own environment/ so no slot reads a sibling's bytes; the verifier re-reads its own copy at grading time, so editing a local copy produces a refused run with reason frozen-axis-moved rather than a different grade.

architecture._head_dim_note: head_dim defaults to 128 in CausalSelfAttention.__init__ at train_gpt_simple.py line 91, and num_heads is model_dim // head_dim, so 768 // 128 is 6.

run._batch_note: batch_size = 8 * 64 * 1024 at train_gpt_simple.py line 249, counted in tokens rather than sequences.
run._target_note: Runs must attain below 3.28 val loss, matching the llm.c GPT-2 replication, per the record set README benchmark definition.

corpus._val_note: The validation split is deliberately absent from every agent-visible container. The number that scores a submission is computed by the verifier on a held-out split the solver cannot see, from parameter snapshots the pinned harness wrote.

anchors._anchor_note: Read from the notable results history table in the record set README. Record 36 is the tuned baseline and record 46 is the standing world record.

free_axes_note: What is free is named per slot by that slot's own statement. This file freezes only the substrate the metric resolves against.
